title: Series Completion Runway by Franchise
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), intake scans (`collection:scan`), market prices (`collection:price`), item photos (`collection:photo`), authentication records (`collection:auth`), loans (`collection:loan`), and condition audits (`collection:condition`).
app: Collection telemetry from personal catalogues, NFC scans, pricing feeds, authentication records, loan logs, shelf measurements, and item-condition audits streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:item
| stats count as owned_items latest(total_known_items) as total_known_items by franchise
| eval completion_pct=round(100*owned_items/total_known_items,1)
| sort completion_pct
description: Shows how complete each series or franchise is relative to the total set you are tracking.
value: Completion percentage makes long-term collecting goals feel tangible and helps balance breadth against finishing what you started.
implementation: Maintain a total-known-items count for each franchise and compare it with the number already owned in your catalogue.
visualization: Bar chart of franchise completion percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how close you are to finishing each series or franchise in your collection.
